name: Samsung
warrantyNote: Samsung Pakistan gives 12 months on the phone and 6 months on the battery, repaired at Samsung or authorised service centres, and only for units bought from an authorised Samsung dealer with the original invoice and warranty card.

name: Xiaomi
warrantyNote: Xiaomi Pakistan gives a 1 year limited warranty on the phone and 6 months on the bundled battery, charger and accessories, valid in Pakistan only and serviced by Xiaomi or its authorised service centres.

name: OPPO
warrantyNote: OPPO Pakistan gives 12 months on the phone and 6 months on the charger, cable and other accessories, honoured at OPPO service centres with a valid warranty card and invoice.

name: vivo
warrantyNote: vivo Pakistan gives 12 months on the phone and 6 months on the charger, cable and earphones for units sold in Pakistan, honoured at any vivo authorised service centre with a valid proof of purchase.

name: realme
warrantyNote: realme Pakistan gives 12 months on the phone and 6 months on the battery, charger and other accessories, honoured at realme service centres with a valid warranty card and invoice.

name: Infinix
warrantyNote: Infinix after-sales service in Pakistan is handled by Carlcare, where you can check a unit's warranty status by IMEI, but we could not find an official Infinix Pakistan page stating the warranty length.

name: Tecno
warrantyNote: TECNO Pakistan routes warranty claims through Carlcare service centres and lets you check a unit's warranty status by IMEI, but its Pakistan site does not state the warranty length.

name: itel
warrantyNote: itel after-sales service in Pakistan is handled by Carlcare service centres, but we could not find an official itel Pakistan page stating the warranty length, so confirm the terms with the seller before buying.

name: HONOR
warrantyNote: HONOR Pakistan lists authorised service centres on its site, and HONOR says its warranty only covers phones bought through official HONOR channels, but we could not find a Pakistan page stating the warranty length.

name: ZTE
warrantyNote: We could not find an official ZTE Pakistan website or published Pakistan warranty policy, so confirm the warranty length and who honours it with the seller before buying.

name: Apple
warrantyNote: Apple has no store in Pakistan; PTA approved iPhones come through authorised distributors such as Mercantile and GNEXT, which offer a 2 year warranty serviced at authorised Apple service centres. Non-PTA units usually carry only the seller's own warranty.

name: POCO
warrantyNote: POCO is Xiaomi's sub-brand, so official units get Xiaomi Pakistan's warranty: 1 year on the phone and 6 months on the bundled battery, charger and accessories, serviced by Xiaomi or its authorised service centres.
